Kunskapsöverföring från Röda Korsets Center för Torterade Flyktingar till Huma

description.narrative: As part of HRFT's programme in Turkey thw RCC shall transfer knowledge to the organization as well as support the development of new methodologies.

PLEASE REVIEW YOUR ANSWER AS THE QUESTION HAS BEEN CHANGED
RKC skall i linje med bifogad ansökan inom tre områden stödja HRFT i att uppnå sina mål enligt stratgisk plan som ligger till grund för Sida:s kärnstöd till organisationen, presenterade i HRFT:s resultatmatris.
För det första kommer RGC konsulteras i utveckling av HRFT:s metoder inom kognitiv beteende-terap (KBT) och psykodynamisk terapi, psycho-educational interventions, gruppmöten med mödraroch barn för att förebygga andra-generationens traumatisering samt gruppsamtal med medisinsk yoga.
För det andra kommer RKC och HRFT att organisera gruppmöten och utbyte av erfarenheter camt behandlin med fokus på presentationer av nya metoder och framgångsrika tillvägagångssätt inom dessa områden.
För det tredje kommer individuella möten mellan kolleger med sammayrkesmässiga och teoretiska bakgrund organiseras.

Objective of the intervention is to facilitate knowledge sharing between HRFT and RCC in the form of one exchange visit from RCC to HRFT and another one from HRFT to RCC per year so that both organizations are up to date about techniques on rehabilitation of torture survivors.
RCC has an objective to support HRFT in their long term objective to offer torture survivors competent treatment and rehabilitation to achieve a state of complete physical, psychological and social well being. RCC will offer consultations in specific treatment methods.
RCC will provide lectures, work shops and joint discussions. HRFT will invite other key actors working with torture survivors and/or refugees as part of the exchange meetings.

Some examples of results of the partnership:
-both parties have gained knowledge from each other. The two partners provide technical knowledge to each other. RCC is the main provider of theory and methodology but HRFT has an expertise working in the Turkish context and the Istanbul protocol.
-Exchange of experience and clinical cases have allowed for partners to gain new perspectives.
-HRFT gets support from RCC in Turkey given the conditions and RCC feel part of a wider picture.
- Exchange visits which have taken place in Stockholm have given participants from HRFT a safe place and a way to get away from the daily life.
